animations.name: Aurora Tide
animations.description: A luminous aurora sweeps across the display in teal, blue, violet, and coral.

animations.name: Ocean Drops
animations.description: Layered ocean ripples expand and roll across the full display.

animations.name: Prism Loom
animations.description: Color curtains weave around a bright seam, then resolve into a warm glow.

animations.name: Great Wave
animations.description: An original indigo wave curls and rolls across the display in a woodblock-inspired palette.

animations.name: Neon Highway
animations.description: A retro cyberpunk sunset anchors a luminous highway while cyan and magenta road lines stream toward the viewer.

animations.name: Ghost Parade
animations.description: Red, pink, cyan, and orange arcade ghosts march across a glowing full-screen backdrop.

animations.name: Mushroom Run
animations.description: Mario hits a question block, grabs a mushroom, grows, and runs past a green pipe beneath a bright 8-bit sky.
